style_doc_files: style docstrings and code examples in Python and MDX files using ruff formatting
style_file_docstrings: style all docstrings in a Python file and return the cleaned code with any ruff errors
style_mdx_file: format all Python code samples in an MDX documentation file using ruff
style_docstrings_in_code: style all docstrings within a Python code string and return the cleaned code
format_code_example: format a Python code example using ruff with doctest support and configurable line length
